messages:
Sam: quick check — I'm trying to get two new variants into the catalog this week (gale-3b-int8, gale-3b-4bit). Are we clear on ownership, license status, and a perf canary? @Alejandra @Jordan
Alejandra: +1 to listing, but I need legal to sign off on the license terms before we publish. I'll ping legal now.
Jordan: did a quick perf sweep on int8 earlier — latency looks fine, cost down ~30%. Need the quant artifacts + a short README line about expected token shapes. Can infra run a short canary on staging?
Tess: infra can run a small canary tomorrow AM. tagging @infra-oncall for GPU slot. what's the minimal manifest we want committed?
Sam: here's a minimal manifest snippet to attach to the intake PR:
```json
{
  "model": "gale-3b",
  "variant": "int8",
  "quant": "8bit",
  "owner": "Jordan",
  "license": "TBD"
}
```
Alejandra: Legal flagged a potential downstream attribution clause in the gale family license — legal-bot will drop specifics. We may need a short customer-facing note for enterprise.
legal-bot: ATTENTION: gale-3b license requires attribution in docs and prohibits standalone redistribution in enterprise bundles without a signed addendum. See: https://redwood.internal/legal/licenses/gale. If you need an exception, open a request with legal@redwood.
Jordan: ok I'll add the license field and a link to the legal page in the manifest. I'll open the perf PR now: https://github.com/redwood/models/pull/482 (perf numbers + quant artifacts).
Sam: can we aim to merge manifest + perf PR before Friday? who takes ownership of the final checklist?
Jordan: I'll own the perf PR and the manifest updates.
Alejandra: I'll own license clearance + a one-line customer note template we can attach to catalog entry. ETA EOD tomorrow for legal ok.
Tess: I'll schedule the canary for 09:00 UTC tomorrow and post results here. @infra-oncall confirmed a small GPU slot reserved.
infra-oncall: confirmed — canary queued for 2024-05-16 09:00 UTC, will run up to 10k tokens and post logs to staging-run-482.
Sam: sweet. Action items: Jordan (perf PR + manifest), Alejandra (legal + note), Tess (canary), Sam (update catalog checklist after merges). Please ack. :thumbsup:
Jordan: ack, starting on PR now.
Alejandra: ack. will update once legal signs off.
Tess: ack — will post canary link here once complete.
Sam: thanks team :eyes:
